actions.descriptionHtml: You expend a level 1+ spell slot. dex DC equals {@dcYourSpellSave}, each creature in a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long Line [Area of Effect]. {@actSaveFail} 2d10 Radiant damage per level of the spell slot expended. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

bonusActions.name: Rampager (Requires Druid Level 10+)
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: You expend a level 1+ spell slot and move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack. When you enter the space of an enemy that is at least two sizes smaller than you for the first time on a turn, that creature is subjected to the following effect. str DC equals {@dcYourSpellSave}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the Prone condition. If the target already has the Prone condition, it instead takes 1d10 Bludgeoning damage per level of the spell slot expended.

actions.name: Energizing Pollen
actions.descriptionHtml: You expend a level 1+ spell slot and can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack while emitting a cloud of healing pollen. When you move within 5 feet of another creature during this movement, you can restore a number of Hit Points equal to 2d6 per level of the spell slot expended. A creature can receive this healing only once per turn.
